verdict_rules.efficient: Reliable, verified success on the same tasks no lower than the baseline (paired difference >= 0), and at least 20% fewer median model calls or input tokens per successful run.
verdict_rules.not_supported: Verified success no higher than the baseline's on development tasks, or worse on held-out tasks.
verdict_rules.promising_but_unproven: Higher verified success than the baseline on the development tasks, but the paired interval includes zero, or it was not confirmed on held-out tasks, or it is not reliable.
verdict_rules.reliable: No safety violation in any run, a false-completion rate no higher than the baseline's, and a verified-success rate on held-out tasks no lower than the baseline's (point estimates, same model).
